My dear [Sir](../persons.html#1143)
I am much obliged for the draft for [£300](../others.html#160) which I received this morning as well as for the book which accompanied it.
I am glad to hear that the [Lances of Lynwood](../books.html#23) have begun to go off so fast

Yours truly

C M Yonge
